desc: Three different gun care kits. Choose from among Compact, Multi Bit and Deluxe for any of your home gunsmithing needs. If you need fast and light but big on options, the Compact kit is ideal for you. It includes a magnetic tipped hex bit driver and a variety of tool bits to address the most common gunsmith needs. If professional grade tools for home gun work, check out the Multi Bit kit. This edition adds a large assortment of flat bits to the Compact Kit for more versatility to fit a wider variety of screw heads used on firearms. However, if you are an accomplished 'smith, the 88-piece Deluxe kit is right up your alley. There's a punch set, hammer, and bench block to the Multi Bit for a complete kit for the professional or at home gunsmith. Each kit comes with quality bits and driver.
